title.en: Company, share capital and kinds of shares
title.kn: ಕಂಪನಿ, ಷೇರು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮತ್ತು ಷೇರುಗಳ ವಿಧಗಳು

heading.en: Owning a tiny slice of a big company

hook.en: Lakhs of people own shares of large Indian companies. How can so many owners share one business, and why is each of them liable only for the money they agreed to pay?
hook.kn: ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಜನರು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಕಂಪನಿಗಳ ಷೇರುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಇಷ್ಟು ಮಾಲೀಕರು ಒಂದು ವ್ಯಾಪಾರವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಅವರ ಹೊಣೆ ಏಕೆ ಸೀಮಿತ?

objectives.en: State the features of a company
Explain the categories of share capital

narration.en: Lakhs of people own shares of large Indian companies. How can so many owners share one business, and why is each of them liable only for the money they agreed to pay? Let us understand the company and its share capital.
narration.kn: ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಜನರು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಭಾರತೀಯ ಕಂಪನಿಗಳ ಷೇರುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಇಷ್ಟು ಮಾಲೀಕರು ಒಂದು ವ್ಯಾಪಾರವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಮತ್ತು ಅವರ ಹೊಣೆ ಏಕೆ ಸೀಮಿತ? ಕಂಪನಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅದರ ಷೇರು ಬಂಡವಾಳವನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ.

body.en: A company is an artificial person created by law, with a separate legal entity, perpetual succession, limited liability of members and transferable shares (for a public company). A private company has at least 2 and at most 200 members; a public company needs at least 7 members; a One Person Company has one member.
body.kn: ಕಂಪನಿ ಕಾನೂನಿನಿಂದ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಯಾದ ಕೃತಕ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ. ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಕಾನೂನು ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವ, ಶಾಶ್ವತ ಉತ್ತರಾಧಿಕಾರ, ಸೀಮಿತ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಇದರ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು. ಖಾಸಗಿ ಕಂಪನಿಯಲ್ಲಿ 2 ರಿಂದ 200 ಸದಸ್ಯರು; ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಕಂಪನಿಗೆ ಕನಿಷ್ಠ 7 ಸದಸ್ಯರು.

title.en: On the board: Layers of share capital

narration.en: Authorised capital is the ceiling written in the memorandum: ten lakh rupees.

say.en: Authorised capital is the ceiling written in the memorandum: ten lakh rupees.
The company offered and received applications for sixty thousand shares of ten rupees: subscribed capital six lakh.
Only eight rupees a share has been called up: four lakh eighty thousand.
Two rupees on one thousand shares is unpaid. That is calls in arrears; take it away to get paid-up capital.

body.en: Authorised capital is the maximum the company may issue (in its memorandum). Issued capital is the part offered to the public; subscribed capital is the part taken up. Called-up capital is the part of subscribed capital the company has asked for; paid-up capital is the called-up amount actually received. Reserve capital is the part of uncalled capital that, by special resolution, will be called only on winding up.
body.kn: ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಮಿತಿ. ನೀಡಿದ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕರಿಗೆ ನೀಡಿದ ಭಾಗ; ಚಂದಾ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿದ ಭಾಗ. ಕರೆದ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಕೇಳಿದ ಭಾಗ; ಪಾವತಿಸಿದ ಬಂಡವಾಳ ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಬಂದ ಮೊತ್ತ. ಮೀಸಲು ಬಂಡವಾಳವನ್ನು ಸಮಾಪನದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಕರೆಯಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Equity shares: no preference; vote; residual owners
Preference shares: preferential right to fixed dividend and to return of capital on winding up

title.en: Try it: called-up and paid-up capital

caption.en: Shares of ₹10 each. Choose how many were subscribed, how much is called per share, and the unpaid calls.

narration.en: Called-up capital depends on how much the company has asked for; paid-up capital is what it has actually received.

tryThis.en: Call the full ₹10 with no arrears: which three figures become equal?
Set the unpaid amount to 0: is there still a difference between called-up and paid-up?

problem.en: A company has authorised capital of ₹10,00,000 in shares of ₹10 each. It issued and received subscriptions for 60,000 shares. ₹8 per share has been called up. Calls of ₹2 per share on 1,000 shares are unpaid. Find the called-up and paid-up capital.

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. A company has authorised capital of ₹10,00,000 in shares of ₹10 each. It issued and received subscriptions for 60,000 shares. ₹8 per share has been called up. Calls of ₹2 per share on 1,000 shares are unpaid. Find the called-up and paid-up capital.

body.en: Authorised ≥ Issued ≥ Subscribed ≥ Called-up ≥ Paid-up. Each step down is a part of the step above.

narration.en: The capital ladder. Authorised ≥ Issued ≥ Subscribed ≥ Called-up ≥ Paid-up. Each step down is a part of the step above.

mnemonic.en: A-I-S-C-P: All Indians Save Clean Paise

narration.en: Roll call quiz. When your roll number is called, give your answer.
narration.kn: ಹಾಜರಾತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕ್ರಮಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಕರೆದಾಗ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉತ್ತರ ಹೇಳಿ.

points.en: A company is a separate legal entity with limited liability.
points.kn: ಕಂಪನಿ ಸೀಮಿತ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆಯ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಕಾನೂನು ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವ.

points.en: Preference shares get priority for dividend and return of capital.
points.kn: ಆದ್ಯತಾ ಷೇರುಗಳಿಗೆ ಲಾಭಾಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ವಾಪಸಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆದ್ಯತೆ.

homework.en: Show the share capital of the worked example as it appears in the notes to accounts.

narration.en: Recap. A company is a separate legal entity with limited liability. Authorised ≥ issued ≥ subscribed ≥ called-up ≥ paid-up. Preference shares get priority for dividend and return of capital.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಕಂಪನಿ ಸೀಮಿತ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆಯ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಕಾನೂನು ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವ. ಅಧಿಕೃತ ≥ ನೀಡಿದ ≥ ಚಂದಾ ≥ ಕರೆದ ≥ ಪಾವತಿಸಿದ. ಆದ್ಯತಾ ಷೇರುಗಳಿಗೆ ಲಾಭಾಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ಬಂಡವಾಳ ವಾಪಸಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆದ್ಯತೆ.
